exposure: History of three or more spontaneous consecutive abortions
General diseases (asthma, diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular disease)
Previous stillbirth or intrauterine death or manual removal of placenta
outcome: Proportion of risk factors among pregnant women
cohort: 403 pregnant women attending antenatal checkup unit of Model Family Planning Clinic of Mymensingh Medical College Hospital, Bangladesh
finding: The proportion of women with high risk pregnancy in this study is 24.1%.
